The '''2019 Bespin Regionals''' was a 6-round Swiss tournament on 28 July 2019 at Level Up Games in Eagan, Minnesota, the second day of the Bespin Super Weekend, organized by [[Mark Walseth]].<ref name="bespin19ann">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1262921#p1262921 Bespin Super Weekend - July 27th and 28th], Walsetmd, Players Committee forum (5 July 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122225001/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1267501.html Internet Archive]</ref> Bryan M won when [[Charlie Arlandson]] gave him the title; Charlie wanted the Lego BB-8.<ref name="bespin19">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1267501#p1267501 Bespin Super Weekend - July 27th and 28th], Walsetmd, Players Committee forum (3 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122225001/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1267501.html Internet Archive]</ref>
